name: Hive Hub (UK)

radios.note: Hive's Hub page lists Ethernet to the router, Wi-Fi and Zigbee. Bluetooth is not listed for this model (the older Hub 360 had it).

matter.note: No Matter claim found for the Hive Hub.

apple_home.note: Hive's Hub page says the product can be used with Apple HomeKit and Siri Shortcuts. Which Hive devices appear in Apple Home was not checked.

google_home.note: Hive devices are added in the Google Home app by linking the Hive account.

alexa.note: Enable the Hive skill; Hive lists its thermostats, sensors and Hive 2 devices as supported.

smartthings.note: No official source found; only community posts.

home_assistant.note: Official Hive integration using your Hive account (cloud polling); the hub itself is not paired to Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: It is the hub that Hive heating and home devices connect through.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from an official source.

deviceProtocols.note: Zigbee to Hive thermostats, radiator valves, plugs and sensors.

summary: The Hive Hub is the Zigbee hub that Hive heating and home devices connect through, linked to your router by Ethernet or Wi-Fi. Hive devices are controlled by Alexa and Google Home through Hive's own integrations.
caveats: Hive sells a Hub (Nano3-style, Ethernet or Wi-Fi) now; the older Hub 360 and original hub are different models.
Hive says Alexa and Google Home need the Hive account linked and the devices on the same Wi-Fi.
The hub is not a general Zigbee hub for third-party devices.
